description:
As DevOps Engineer, you will work alongside Adrian Andrei in Bucharest to bring new GPU nodes into service and keep the running ones healthy. Once the hardware team has built and tested a system, you take it from there: operating system, drivers, acceptance tests and handover to production. When a node misbehaves, you are the person on site who can look at both the software and the machine.

Success means new nodes join the fleet through one repeatable process, no node takes customer load before it has passed acceptance, and Adrian can hand you routine operations with confidence.

What you'll do
  • Provision new GPU nodes: install and configure the operating system, drivers and container runtime using our automation.
  • Run acceptance tests and GPU diagnostics on every node, record the results and fix or escalate failures.
  • Monitor the pods in Bucharest through our metrics and Elasticsearch logs, respond to alerts, and work with the hardware technicians when the cause is physical.
  • Carry out routine operations: OS and driver updates, node reboots and drains, access requests and inventory records.
  • Help during incidents as the local person who can reach the machines, and write up what happened.
  • Improve the scripts and runbooks you use, so each task takes less manual work the next time.
  • Build and maintain CI pipelines in GitHub Actions and infrastructure on Google Cloud with the rest of the DevOps team.
  • Use AI agents in your daily work to automate routine tasks and investigate problems faster.
  • Take part in the infrastructure on-call rota once trained.
What we're looking for
  • 3+ years running Linux servers in production, in DevOps, system administration, or data centre or hosting operations.
  • Strong Linux skills: networking basics, systemd, storage, logs and troubleshooting from the command line.
  • Hands-on experience with a public cloud. Google Cloud (GCP) is preferred, as that is what we run on.
  • CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Scripting in Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Docker.
  • Incident management experience, and willingness to join an on-call rota.
  • You have used AI agents in your own work for at least the past six months.
  • Self-driven: you spot problems and fix them on your own initiative instead of waiting to be asked.
  • Careful and procedural: you follow the runbook, note where it is wrong and fix it.
  • Good spoken and written English, for daily work with colleagues across Europe and the US.
  • Based in or near Bucharest and able to work on site.
Nice to have
  • Experience with NVIDIA GPUs: drivers, CUDA, DCGM diagnostics.
  • Previous on-call support for production systems.
  • Elasticsearch for logging and search.
  • Configuration management and infrastructure as code: Ansible, Terraform.
  • Kubernetes administration.
  • Monitoring and incident tools (Prometheus, Grafana, incident.io).
  • Server hardware experience: IPMI and BMC, firmware, part replacement.
  • Romanian.
